subtitle: Out Manila · Philippine Airlines
overview: Fly direct to Beijing with Philippine Airlines and stay five nights in a 5★ hotel. You visit Tiananmen Square, the Forbidden City, the Juyongguan Great Wall and the Temple of Heaven, with a Hanfu experience and a foot massage along the way. Day 5 is free, with an optional Universal Studios Beijing trip, and the guide is English-speaking.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Mar 2–7 2027 to Jun 29–Jul 4 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Water Cube: The swimming venue of the 2008 Olympics, seen from outside.
placeDesc.Bird’s Nest: Beijing's National Stadium, the main stadium of the 2008 Olympics, seen from outside.
placeDesc.Wangfujing Walking Street: A busy pedestrian shopping and snack street in central Beijing.
placeDesc.Tiananmen Square: The huge central square of Beijing, beside the entrance to the Forbidden City.
placeDesc.Forbidden City: The former imperial palace of China's Ming and Qing emperors, in the centre of Beijing.
placeDesc.Juyongguan Great Wall: A well-preserved section of the Great Wall in a mountain pass north of Beijing.
placeDesc.Temple of Heaven: A park with Ming-era temple halls where emperors once prayed for good harvests.
placeDesc.Qianmen Old Street: A restored pedestrian street south of Tiananmen Square with traditional shops.
